events.title: House Show
events.description:
CCB House Teams perform longform improv comedy!

Every Friday of the month, CCB features its 4 House Teams: Brace! Brace!, Handshake, Capiche, and Secret Lovers!

About the teams:

Brace! Brace! (2nd & 4th Fridays) is Anita Waltho, Georgia Riungu, Jared Lorenzo, Julia Lang, Kathy MacLeod, Keshia Fredua-Mensah, Pip Roper, Simone O’Donovan, Tina Marie Serra and Zoe Langer. They are coached by Noah Telson.

Capiche (2nd & 3rd Fridays) is Evelyn Ferguson, Harry Ritche, Ilana Ullman, Jason Porter, Marie-Laure Gagné, Sonia Williams, Terezie Fendrychova, Tetiana Mulenko and Vishal Bala. They are coached by Antonia Bär.

Secret Lovers (1st & 3rd Fridays) is Connor Belshaw, Deschna Afram, Kevin Zhou, Sam Caravaglia, Sanja Bjelica, Sarah Binder and Tommy Grover. They are coached by Michele Guido.

events.title: GLB – Improvised Comedy
events.description:
GLB is CCB’s premier improv team, Berlin’s longest running English-language longform improv team and has performed to packed houses across Europe.

With a suggestion from the audience, GLB sets off on a night of first rate tomfoolery – hilarious scenes weaved together with incomparable timing. Pretty much anything can happen, and it’s all made up before your very eyes by some of the best improvisers this city’s got to offer.

GLB is Amy Jane, Ben Southam, Nicole Ratjen, Josh Telson & Noah Telson.

events.title: Forms Night
events.description:
Forms Night showcases various, and often under represented, improv formats. It is a chance to see seasoned improvisers going out of their comfort zones, trying out new things, maybe even bending space and time all in an effort to make you laugh.

Maybe you’ve heard of the Harold or the Pretty Flower and want to see what else is possible. Maybe you’re not aware of what an “Improv Form” is. It really doesn’t matter at all. The most important thing to know is the show is free, funny and different every time.

events.title: The Shakedown – Musical Improv
events.description: Come spend the night with The Shakedown, the rebel musicians of Berlin’s improv comedy scene. Shaking up stages since 2019, The Shakedown spin improvised songs and stories completely on the fly, shocking and delighting audiences with their audacious mix of wit, charm, and mischief. Brace yourselves for an electrifying night of passion, laughter, and rule-breaking musical mayhem!

events.title: Full Fat Bear Milk
events.description:
Come and watch one of Berlin’s finest improv teams, Bear Milk, as they bring you an hour of hilarious, sometimes touching, and downright bizarre comedy.

In their monthly show Full-Fat, Bear Milk effortlessly weaves together a one-act play packed full of laughs, crisscrossing storylines, and larger-than-life characters, all told in real time and made up on the spot. You will not be disappointed.

events.title: The CCB Improv Jam
events.description:
The CCB Improv Jam is an open stage for improvisers looking to practice, have fun or try out long-form improv for the first time. It’s also fun to just watch!

Anyone can join and everyone can play.

If you’d like to play, just put your name on the sign up sheet when you arrive and we’ll draw teams randomly until everyone’s had a chance to perform. You’ll be joined by complete beginners, current and former CCBTS students, members of CCB House Teams as well as numerous other indie teams.

It’s fun, it’s relaxed and super supportive! All experience levels welcome.

If you’d like to watch, reserve your tickets below.

The CCB Improv Jam is hosted by a different improv team every week.

events.title: Berlinians
events.description:
What is Berlin? A crumbling pleasure dome? A playground for the weirdos of the world? A constant stream of trash to sorted into 4 distinct bins?

No longer must you struggle with these questions alone. Berlinians is a comedy show in which the city’s best improvisers and brain trust for all things Berlin will turn your strangest local experiences into comedic gold. Our eclectic mix of born-and-raised-, naturalized- and recent-transplant Berliner comedians are here to answer all your questions about this elusive city.

Whether you’re visiting for the weekend and want to get a tutorial on the city, you’re new in town and want answers, or you’re a seasoned U-Bahn cowboy, Berlinians will make you love Germany’s land locked island (again). Reviews from our audience:

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “Such a fun show — funny, engaging and interesting. Felt very Berlin, without resorting to well-worn tropes or cheap cliches. Highly recommend!”

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “Berlinians is such a great show. Fast paced, bizarre and hilarious. I laughed my arse off from start to finish!”

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “If you want a hilarious love letter to the city’s quirks (good and bad), The Berlinians delivers. It’s a wildly fun show featuring Berlin’s best clichés

events.title: Improvylicious Jam
events.description:
Improvylicious Jam, hosted by Destiny’s Step Child, is an open stage for anyone looking to practice, have fun or try out long-form improv for the first time, in particular those improvisers (and non-improvisers!) who identify as BIPOC. This jam is open for everyone to watch and play and we encourage people of color to participate.

If you’d like to play, just put your name on the sign up sheet when you arrive and we’ll draw teams randomly until everyone’s had a chance to perform. You’ll be joined by complete beginners, current and former CCBTS students, members of CCB House Teams as well as numerous other indie teams.

It’s fun, it’s relaxed and super supportive! All experience levels welcome. Improvylicious Jam is a safe space for BIPOC people to jam and is hosted by a BIPOC team.

If you’d like to watch, reserve your tickets below.

events.title: Smash Cut Presents: The Improvised Movie
events.description: Turn down the lights and get out the popcorn! A team of CCB’s finest filmmaking improvisers gather together to create live cinema right in front of your face! Featuring Oscar-worthy screenwriting, impossible camera angles and some of the finest acting you’ll ever see, don’t miss it ’cause this one won’t be in theaters ever (again).

events.title: The Indie Improv Show
events.description: The Indie Improv Show is a celebration of the CCB community’s growing longform improv comedy scene. This show spotlights new and old teams alike that have been working hard making folks laugh all over the city.

events.title: Team Jam
events.description:
It’s like a regular improv jam, but you sign up as a team instead of an individual. Your team can be people you’ve never played with before, people from class, people you met at a regular jam, etc. It could even be people you already play with, but there’s simply not enough stage time for you!

Anyone can join and everyone can play.

Note: you can also just attend and watch the jam—you don’t have to sign up if you don’t want to.

How it works: Arrive 15 mins before showtime to sign up with your team (if you want to jam). The amount of stage time depends on how many teams sign up. For example: if 10 teams sign up, they’ll get about 5 minutes per team. If you come alone, we’ll make a “mixer” group for you to play in.

The purpose of this jam is to help kickstart more indie teams, enable more stage time for beginners, and provide an opportunity for folks to play with people they don’t usually get a chance to play with, and to have fun of course! If your team already plays a lot (a house team or ones with a regular show, for example, maybe hold back on signing up for this).

The regular tips for a good improv jam still apply.

events.title: Laughing Matter – auf Deutsch
events.description:
Seid ihr bereit für ein Experiment? Wir mixen seltsame Wissenschaft mit absurder Impro-Comedy. Ein Team aus Berlins lustigsten Impro-Nerds und Wissenschafts-Fans dekonstruiert den echten Vortrag einer echten Person aus der Forschung. Seid dabei und verlasst die Show mit mehr Wissen über ein hochaktuelles wissenschaftliches Thema. Es sei denn, ihr kommt selbst aus der Wissenschaft – dann können wir nicht garantieren, dass ihr am Ende nicht irgendwie weniger wissen werdet. Aber hey, ihr seid die Fachleute: Warum sollten wir euch irgendwas erzählen!?

Laughing Matter, Berlins erstes Wissenschafts-Comedy-Team spielt seit drei Jahren in Berliner Clubs, bei der Berlin Science Week und auf akademischen Konferenzen. Und jetzt zum ersten Mal in deutscher Sprache.

Diese Show ist Teil des Begleitprogramms zum Skeptival 2026: https://skeptival.org.
Laughing Matter spendet alle Einnahmen aus dieser Show an Skeptix e.V. https://skeptix.org

events.title: Witch Hunt
events.description:
Let Berlin’s most bewitching comedians enchant you every month at Witch Hunt. You’ll be charmed by spellbinding standup, improbable improv, and captivating stories that plague the patriarchy.

With a dash of playful madness and unapologetic artistry, we’ll break the curse of all-mustache lineups and hacky dick jokes. Please be advised that all assholes will be turned into toads.

Hosted by: Lisa Frischemeier

“Lovely Crowd, amazing performers, hot friendly host, 10/10 experience!” ★★★★★ Rocio Ciganda

“Witch Hunt, is just an hour of comedy, but feels like a whole adventure park of fun: stand-up, improv, songs. Every time I went, I felt deliciously entertained.” ★★★★★ Freddi Gralle

“I didn’t expect it to be that funny.” ★★★★★ Random audience member

WE ARE WITCHES AND WE WILL HUNT YOU!

events.title: Student Show – Level 2 – Long Form Fundamentals
events.description:
Join us as the Level 2 class takes the stage to present their deepening understanding of long form comedic improv! These performers have spent the term strengthening the basics with an emphasis on the North American long form approach. Watch as they demonstrate their commitment to characters and scenes, focusing their energies on developing dynamic and relatable characters, and exploring specific comedic ideas.

As a student showcase, this performance is a critical learning opportunity for the performers. We invite you to support their work but please keep in mind they are not professional comedians.

This show is not ticketed and space is reserved first for family and friends of the students.

events.title: Student Show – Level 5 – Long Form Performance
events.description:
Join us as the latest Level 5 class take the stage to demonstrate their grasp of long form improvisation! Having now finished the curriculum, these students are now ready to perform The Governor, an improv form developed at Comedy Café Berlin. Watch as they put the theory of “Truth of the Scene” and “Game of the Scene” into practice, building grounded characters that then explode into wild comedic threads, unexpected turns, and (hopefully) guaranteed laughs. This showcase is the culmination of their journey to become multi-faceted and confident performers, ready to construct complex, hilarious, and unforgettable worlds from a single suggestion.

As a student showcase, this performance is a critical learning opportunity for the performers. We invite you to support their work but please keep in mind they are not professional comedians.

This show is not ticketed and space is reserved first for family and friends of the students.

events.title: Student Show – Level 4 – Long Form Scenework
events.description:
Join us as the Level 4 class takes the stage to demonstrate their growing grasp of long-form improvisation! These performers have spent the session deepening their understanding of Truth of the Scene and Game of the Scene, focusing on premise-based improvisation and the art of comedic patterns.

As a student showcase, this performance is a critical learning opportunity for the performers. We invite you to support their work but please keep in mind they are not professional comedians.

This show is not ticketed and space is reserved first for family and friends of the students.

events.title: Student Show – Level 3 – Long Form Techniques
events.description:
Join us as the Level 3 class demonstrates their growing understanding of long form improvisation! These students have spent the session learning the core concepts of Truth of the Scene and Game of the Scene. Watch as they put these fundamental theories into practice, concentrating their energies on strong, grounded characters and focusing scenes around a single comedic idea.

As a student showcase, this performance is a critical learning opportunity for the performers. We invite you to support their work but please keep in mind they are not professional comedians.

This show is not ticketed and space is reserved first for family and friends of the students.

events.title: Student Show – Level 1 – Intro to Improv
events.description:
Join us as the Level 1 class makes their improv debut! This is a moment of excitement and discovery for students with little to no previous experience.

Over the term, these performers have been learning the basic skills every improviser needs to make scenes as successful as possible. Watch as they focus on making positive choices, demonstrating basic scene work, and building strong group support. They’ll explore the fundamental kernels of what makes something funny and demonstrate their ability to get out of their shell and onto the stage. This showcase is the exciting culmination of their journey into long form comedic improv!

As a student showcase, this performance is a critical learning opportunity for the performers. We invite you to support their work but please keep in mind they are not professional comedians.

This show is not ticketed and space is reserved first for family and friends of the students.

events.title: Truth Night
events.description:
Truth Night is an evening of slow burning, “speed-of-life” improv comedy. Lights go down, lights come up, and the show begins. Everything is improvised and inspired by the moment.

Intrigued? Join us for an evening of honest discovery and “it’s-funny-because-it’s-true” comedy.

events.title: Action Jackson
events.description:
Action Jackson are a somewhat-international long-form improv comedy group. They perform an Armando, improvising their set from a true life monologue inspired by an audience suggestion. They have been referred to as some of the biggest improv nerds in Berlin. Action Jackson have been seen internationally at the Edinburgh Improv Festival, Reykjavik International Improv Festival, Del Close Marathon in NYC, Barcelona Improv Festival, Das Improv Festival and the Berlin Fringe.

They are Amanda King, Antonia Bär, Caroline Clifford, Matilde Keizer, Noah Telson, Steindor Jonsson and Trevor Silverstein.

events.title: Tales Held Dear
events.description:
Grab your foam sword, strap on your pointy ears, and get ready to delve into the world of Berlinia for an epic fantasy quest, as suggested by you, the audience!

Every show features a new party of adventurers hacking and slashing their way through a fully improvised quest, inspired by Dungeons & Dragons, the classic fantasy roleplaying game.

Tales Held Dear regular cast is Carl Clancy, Tetiana Mulenko, Marijne Nieuwerf and Jacob Wolf Lefton.

events.title: Heartbreak Hotel presents… Life Is Trash
events.description:
It’s been a bad year at Heartbreak Hotel and we’re making it your problem!

Join us as we interview special guest comedians about the worst days of their lives and pick apart those stories for the juiciest & most absurd premises, turning our guests’ depseated personal trauma into a fast paced comedy thrill ride with the help of some of CCBs most chaotic improvisers!

Life is Trash is a celebration of the objectively terrible, exploring the darker side of life: death, disease, and terror, and finding catharsis through the power of improv.

events.title: Student Show – Advanced Truth
events.description:
Join us as our Advanced Level students perform a Speed of Life show based on grounded, organic, patient improv.

As a student showcase, this performance is a critical learning opportunity for the performers. We invite you to support their work but please keep in mind they are not professional comedians.

This show is not ticketed and space is reserved first for family and friends of the students.

events.title: The Confession: An Improv Show Worth Repenting For
events.description:
Get ready for The Confession, a riotous improv show fueled by your deepest, darkest secrets! Anonymous audience confessions ignite the chaos, as a star-studded cast brings your most sinful moments to life, with plenty of sacrilegious misunderstandings and unapologetically uncouth behaviour.
Leave your guilt and shame at the door and prepare to walk away feeling absolved, united and free.

events.title: It’s That Time of the Month!
events.description:
A monthly improvised live talk show hosted by Berlin’s funniest women. Join us for a daytime evening of hilarity where we improvise about topics close to our hearts and dish out life advice on all things necessary. A non award winning show.

***disclaimer: Since the show is fully improvised, ITTOTM can never be sure in advance which topics might come up, including serious or sensitive issues related to personal experiences. ITTOTM wants to be mindful about the way they handle tougher issues, while still making you laugh. Please always feel free to approach them with concerns or constructive feedback.***

events.title: Der kleine Impro-Jam auf Deutsch @ CCB Studios
events.description:
Ein offener Jam für alle, die Impro-Comedy kennenlernen möchten. Komm vorbei, schau zu und (wenn du Lust hast) mach gleich mit. Egal, ob du schon Impro-Erfahrung hast oder nicht, bei uns dürfen alle mitspielen. Und wenn dein Deutsch noch nicht so gut ist, gar kein Problem: Missverständnisse sind Comedy-Gold.

Wir schaffen eine entspannte, offene Atmosphäre und unterstützen uns gegenseitig. Wenn du etwas Neues ausprobieren willst und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit anderen überraschende und witzige Szenen zu spielen, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Der Jam findet in den CCB Studios am Hermannplatz statt (nicht im Comedy Café). Der Eintritt ist frei, aber melde dich vorher an, denn der Platz ist beschränkt. Wir freuen uns natürlich auch über Spenden!

Achtung! Einlass erst ab 13.20

events.title: Student Show – Level 1 – Einstiegskurs
events.description:
Seien Sie dabei, wenn die Level 1-Klasse ihr Impro-Debüt gibt! Dies ist ein Moment voller Aufregung und Entdeckung für Teilnehmer mit wenig bis gar keiner Vorerfahrung.

Im Laufe des Semesters haben diese Performer die grundlegenden Fähigkeiten erlernt, die jeder Improvisateur braucht, um Szenen so erfolgreich wie möglich zu gestalten. Erleben Sie, wie sie sich darauf konzentrieren, positive Entscheidungen zu treffen, grundlegende Szenenarbeit zu demonstrieren und starke Gruppenunterstützung aufzubauen. Sie werden die fundamentalen Grundlagen dessen erkunden, was etwas lustig macht, und ihre Fähigkeit unter Beweis stellen, aus sich herauszukommen und auf die Bühne zu gehen. Dieses Showcase ist der aufregende Höhepunkt ihrer Reise in die Langform-Comedy-Improvisation!

Als Studenten-Showcase ist diese Vorstellung eine wichtige Lerngelegenheit für die Performer. Wir laden Sie ein, ihre Arbeit zu unterstützen, aber bitte bedenken Sie, dass sie keine professionellen Comedians sind.

Diese Show ist nicht ticketpflichtig und der Platz ist zuerst für Familie und Freunde der Teilnehmer reserviert.

events.title: Student Show – Level 3 – Techniken der Langform
events.description:
Begleitet uns, wenn die Level-3-Klasse ihr wachsendes Verständnis der Langform-Improvisation unter Beweis stellt! Diese Teilnehmenden haben die Session damit verbracht, die Grundkonzepte von „Truth of the Scene” und „Game of the Scene” zu erlernen. Schaut zu, wie sie diese grundlegenden Theorien in die Praxis umsetzen – mit dem Fokus auf starke, geerdet gespielte Charaktere und Szenen, die sich um eine einzige komödiantische Idee herum entfalten.

Als Studenten-Showcase ist diese Vorstellung eine wichtige Lerngelegenheit für die Performer. Wir laden Sie ein, ihre Arbeit zu unterstützen, aber bitte bedenken Sie, dass sie keine professionellen Comedians sind.

Diese Show ist nicht ticketpflichtig und der Platz ist zuerst für Familie und Freunde der Teilnehmer reserviert.

events.title: The Improvised Stand-Up Show
events.description:
This is a rollercoaster of a show where 8 awesome comedians from the world of Improv and Stand-Up will perform live improvised stand-up comedy.

Topics they have never seen before, that have been prepared by their fellow comedians, will appear projected behind them and they have to act as if it’s all part of their pre-prepared “tight 5”.

It’s a brilliant show where anything can happen. Expect belly-laughs and extreme bombing. Watch these comics squirm!

Hosted by Caroline Clifford and Antonia Bär

Banner by Connor Belshaw

events.title: Don’t Stop
events.description: Don’t Stop! A night of fast paced, nonstop hilarity. 3 teams, 3 slackers, no sweeps, no filler and all killer! Ready, Set, GOOOOO!

events.title: Teacher’s Pet
events.description:
Shine those apples and sharpen those pencils – The CCB Training School teachers are jumping on stage! Interested in what improv at CCB is all about? Taking classes and want to see your teacher in action? Just down for some great comedy? Check, check and check! Every 4th Thursday of the month at Comedy Café Berlin.

Join the CCBTS instructors as they perform a set of their choice followed by a form of the students’ choice! You make ’em sweat and they’ll make you laugh!

Free for current & former CCBTS students (show your registration email at the door).

events.title: Daisy Chain – LGBTQIA+ Ensemble Improv
events.description:
What’s vibrant, sparkly, and will whisk you away into a universe of absurdity and giggles? DAISY CHAIN, an ensemble cast of LGBTQIA+ improvisers!

Don’t miss your chance to catch our monthly hour long show in which we perform 2 sets of long-form improv comedy—filled with compelling scenes, a full spectrum of characters and their relationships, silliness, fever dreams, callbacks, and much more.

Note: you do not have to be LGBTQIA+ in order to watch or enjoy the show. All are welcome!

events.title: Die Dackel-Show
events.description:
Die Dackel-Show: ein Comedy-Abend zum Liebhaben, präsentiert von Berlins längster Improv-Comedy-Gruppe, Dackel.

Für den ersten Teil der Show laden wir unsere allerliebsten Stand-up-Comedians ein, oft mit brandneuem Material.

Im zweiten Teil improvisieren wir, inspiriert von einem Wort von euch, eine komplette kleine Komödie voller schräger Figuren, versponnener Handlungsfäden und dramatischer Wendungen. Nichts ist vorher ausgedacht, alles wird im Moment erfunden. Es wird irre.

——— STIMMEN ZU DACKEL ———

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ „Wie Kino ohne Kamera — live und mittendrin“

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ „Fantastisch“

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ „Große Gefühle, klein erzählt und sehr lustig!“

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ „Besser als Stand-Up“

events.title: Laughing Matter
events.description: Are you ready for an experiment? Let’s mix some weird science with even weirder improv. Berlin’s best and funniest improv nerds are back to deconstruct another real scientific talk from a real scientific person. Come join in the fun and leave the venue knowing more about a particular field of scientific research than you did before. Unless you are a scientist then we can’t guarantee you won’t somehow know less.

events.title: The CCB Improv Jam
events.description:
The CCB Improv Jam is an open stage for improvisers looking to practice, have fun or try out long-form improv for the first time. It’s also fun to just watch!

Anyone can join and everyone can play.

If you’d like to play, just put your name on the sign up sheet when you arrive and we’ll draw teams randomly until everyone’s had a chance to perform. You’ll be joined by complete beginners, current and former CCBTS students, members of CCB House Teams as well as numerous other indie teams.

It’s fun, it’s relaxed and super supportive! All experience levels welcome.

If you’d like to watch, reserve your tickets below.

The CCB Improv Jam is hosted by a different improv team every week.

events.title: Exit Stage Left
events.description:
What happens when you get one trained actor and one clueless improviser on stage to perform a scene together? Join us and find out!

CCB presents an evening of partially improvised scenes from your favorite Broadway productions (we apologize if they become unrecognizable). One theatrically trained actor will be reciting lines from a well known play as one professionally ignorant improviser attempts to play along without knowing what play they’re in.

Arthur Miller eat your heart out.

events.title: Team Jam
events.description:
It’s like a regular improv jam, but you sign up as a team instead of an individual. Your team can be people you’ve never played with before, people from class, people you met at a regular jam, etc. It could even be people you already play with, but there’s simply not enough stage time for you!

Anyone can join and everyone can play.

Note: you can also just attend and watch the jam—you don’t have to sign up if you don’t want to.

How it works: Arrive 15 mins before showtime to sign up with your team (if you want to jam). The amount of stage time depends on how many teams sign up. For example: if 10 teams sign up, they’ll get about 5 minutes per team. If you come alone, we’ll make a “mixer” group for you to play in.

The purpose of this jam is to help kickstart more indie teams, enable more stage time for beginners, and provide an opportunity for folks to play with people they don’t usually get a chance to play with, and to have fun of course! If your team already plays a lot (a house team or ones with a regular show, for example, maybe hold back on signing up for this).

The regular tips for a good improv jam still apply.

events.title: Frei erfunden – Improv Comedy und Jam auf Deutsch
events.description:
Einmal im Monat präsentiert CCB Langform-Improvisations-Comedy in deutscher Sprache. Nur ein Wort vom Publikum und unser Team aus deutschsprachigen Improvisator*innen kreiert eine ganze Comedy-Show – mit Szenen, die nicht geprobt sind, noch nie gezeigt wurden und sich nie wiederholen werden.

Im Anschluss an die Show gibt es einen offenen Improvisations-Jam auf Deutsch. Alle sind willkommen!

events.title: House Show
events.description:
CCB House Teams perform longform improv comedy!

Every Friday of the month, CCB features its 4 House Teams: Brace! Brace!, Handshake, Capiche, and Secret Lovers!

About the teams:

Brace! Brace! (2nd & 4th Fridays) is Anita Waltho, Georgia Riungu, Jared Lorenzo, Julia Lang, Kathy MacLeod, Keshia Fredua-Mensah, Pip Roper, Simone O’Donovan, Tina Marie Serra and Zoe Langer. They are coached by Noah Telson.

Handshake (1st & 4th Fridays) is AdibA, Grant Selland, Harry Haddon, Katie Kerckaert, Laura Kenny, Lucrezia Villani, Poppe, and Theo Mason Wood. Former members include Aviya Cohen and Seema Iyer. They are coached by Josh Telson.

Capiche (2nd & 3rd Fridays) is Adam Ferreira, Evelyn Ferguson, Harry Ritche, Ilana Ullman, Jason Porter, Marie-Laure Gagné, Sonia Williams, Terezie Fendrychova, Tetiana Mulenko and Vishal Bala. They are coached by Antonia Bär.

Secret Lovers (1st & 3rd Fridays) is Connor Belshaw, Deschna Afram, Kevin Zhou, Sam Caravaglia, Sanja Bjelica, Sarah Binder and Tommy Grover. They are coached by Michele Guido.

events.title: GLB – Improvised Comedy
events.description:
GLB is CCB’s premier improv team, Berlin’s longest running English-language longform improv team and has performed to packed houses across Europe.

With a suggestion from the audience, GLB sets off on a night of first rate tomfoolery – hilarious scenes weaved together with incomparable timing. Pretty much anything can happen, and it’s all made up before your very eyes by some of the best improvisers this city’s got to offer.

GLB is Amy Jane, Ben Southam, Nicole Ratjen, Josh Telson & Noah Telson.
